title: Super Tools Additions
description: It for Super Tools Reloaded Mod 1.12.2  Add Without 's Foods 's Addon.
body: This addon adds the missing 1.7.10 foods to the Super Tools Reloaded mod, including Super Beetroot, Super Bread, and Super Soup (Super Beetroot and Super Bread can be cooked).Welcome to play this addonYou must add the dependency mods Super Tools Reloaded and Additions Mod 0.4.6 and Loot Overhaul.
